# root = the player. Rebuild his list of every work in circulation
# (kehillah_lib_refresh_catalog_list_effect, generated by
# scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py) as the page opens.
kehillah_lib_catalog_refresh = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = { kehillah_lib_refresh_catalog_list_effect = yes }
}
